title: Bhai Mani Singh as the Model Sikh and Teacher

blocks.text: The fragment becomes a sustained praise-portrait of Bhai Mani Singh as the model Sikh. He is remembered as disciplined, learned, devout, and steady in judgment, with saintliness and organizational authority held together in one figure.

The page emphasizes that his excellence is not private holiness alone. He strengthens the Panth by teaching Sikhi widely, recounting sacred history, guiding conduct, and giving ordinary Sikhs a living image of fidelity joined to intellect.
In that sense Bhai Mani Singh stands here as a standard for communal leadership. He embodies the kind of character by which the Khalsa preserves doctrine, memory, and discipline under pressure.
